card.name: Route of administration words in dosing sections
card.fires_on: The word for the route of giving a drug (intravenous, subcutaneous, intrathecal), on the route word itself or the word right after it. It appears in dosage and radiation dosimetry sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Route word ending
modes.description: The last piece of a route word such as subcutaneous or intrathecal.

modes.label: Word after route
modes.description: The word 'administration' or similar right after 'intravenous'.
modes.example: for organs and tissues of adults from intravenous<< administration>> of TAUVID.

card.plain: It lights up when a label names how a drug is given, such as under the skin or into a vein.
